mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops > 5% MoM and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases for 3 months and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS drops simultaneously and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both drop > 5% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in a month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances.
